notablePrerequisites:
Robaran Mercenaries does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least seven Rats.
description:
Activate Robaran Mercenaries using Marrow-Gnawer's ability by sacrificing a Rat and tapping it, creating at least six 1/1 Rat creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four Rats, adding {3}{B}.
Activate Robaran Mercenaries using Fain's fourth ability by paying {3}{B}, untapping Robaran Mercenaries.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite creature tokens, you may instead activate Fain's first ability to put infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.
